text:
Ravi Patel: Quick heads-up — we have a candidate for Senior Infra Eng (recruiter said strong SRE infra background) scheduled Thurs 3/10. Candidate is in PST. Can the panel do either 10:00am PT or 11:30am PT? I can take either but prefer earlier.
Liz Chen: I can do 10:00am PT.
Hannah Ortiz: 10:00 conflicts with a rollout check for me. 11:30 PT works.
Ravi Patel: Hmm. If Liz is fine moving to 11:30 that solves it. Otherwise we can swap someone. @Liz any flexibility?
Liz Chen: I can move to 11:30. Please send updated invite.
Ravi Patel: Thanks. I'll update the invite and add a 30min debrief after the interview (15m buffer + 15m debrief). Please plan to stay for debrief.
Liz Chen: Quick rubric q — are we using the new "Interview Rubric v2" or the old one? I want to make sure scoring aligns.
Hannah Ortiz: Also — do we need to record the call? Candidate OK with recording?
Ravi Patel: Use Rubric v2. Candidate said yes to recording (recruiter confirmed). I'll paste the mini-checklist here: 
```
Design: 1-5
Systems: 1-5
Ownership/triage: 1-5
Communication: 1-5
Overall: Hire / No-hire / Hold
```
Ravi Patel: Please fill scores and one-line reasoning per section in the debrief doc within 24 hours. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/interviews/debriefs/senior-infra (recruiter has resume and packet).
Liz Chen: Got it. Any specific areas to lean into for questions? I can take reliability/incident handling.
Hannah Ortiz: I can cover scale and infra design. Ravi — do you want to handle ownership + culture fit?
Ravi Patel: Yes I'll cover ownership + culture and leave a few mins for candidate questions. Also: please ask the standard production-incident question: "Tell us about a time you were paged and how you diagnosed and fixed it" — we want concrete triage + postmortem actions.
Ops Bot: Calendar invites updated and sent to panel + candidate. Recording permission requested.
Liz Chen: One more ask — can we confirm timezone on the invite shows PST? Sometimes it auto-converts weirdly for the candidate.
Ravi Patel: Good call. I'll set timezone to America/Los_Angeles on the event.
Hannah Ortiz: I'll be on mute for first 5 mins, join video at 11:25 PT.
Liz Chen: I'll join at 11:20.
Ravi Patel: OK — final checklist: panel confirmed, Rubric v2, debrief doc link shared, recording OK, timezone set to PST, 30m debrief reserved. Ping me if anyone needs to swap within 4 hours of the interview.
Hannah Ortiz: Sounds good :thumbsup:
Liz Chen: Thanks — see you Thu.
Ravi Patel: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn.
